blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Iloilo kicked off its 6th Artesanias de Iloilo trade fair, serving as a venue for micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs). The event is meant to connect producers with local consumers and bigger markets. DTI-Iloilo Director Dorita Chavez, in her message during the opening ceremony on Monday afternoon, said the celebration speaks strongly of their journey. The activity carries the theme “Kultura kag Handum: Rooted in Culture, Made for the Future.” Chavez said the fair also showcases their culinary arts and culture as Ilonggos.
